content.json:
# FleetWise token usage
Every model call a Foundry agent makes, from Foundry's server-side `chat` spans in Application Insights. Runs started from this repo (`ask_agent`, `memory_demo`, `maf_workflow`) are grouped by their `fleetwise.run` root span. Cost is an estimate from the prices below (defaults: gpt-4o Global Standard, USD per 1M tokens).

content.query:
let calls = AppDependencies
| where tostring(Properties["microsoft.foundry"]) == "True" and tostring(Properties["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "chat"
| extend Agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]), Version = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.version"]),
         Model = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.response.model"]),
         Input = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), Output = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| extend Agent = iif(isempty(Agent), "(model call without agent)", Agent);
let cost = (i: long, o: long) { round(i / 1000000.0 * {InputPrice} + o / 1000000.0 * {OutputPrice}, 4) };
calls
| summarize Input = sum(Input), Output = sum(Output), Calls = count()
| extend Total = Input + Output, Cost = cost(Input, Output)
| project Metric = pack_array("Total tokens", "Input tokens", "Output tokens", "Model calls", "Estimated cost (USD)"),
          Value = pack_array(Total, Input, Output, Calls, Cost)
| mv-expand Metric to typeof(string), Value to typeof(real)
content.title: Agent token usage

content.query:
let calls = AppDependencies
| where tostring(Properties["microsoft.foundry"]) == "True" and tostring(Properties["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "chat"
| extend Agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]), Version = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.version"]),
         Model = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.response.model"]),
         Input = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), Output = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| extend Agent = iif(isempty(Agent), "(model call without agent)", Agent);
let cost = (i: long, o: long) { round(i / 1000000.0 * {InputPrice} + o / 1000000.0 * {OutputPrice}, 4) };
let runs = AppDependencies
| where Name == "fleetwise.run"
| project OperationId, Started = TimeGenerated, Run = tostring(Properties["fleetwise.run_id"]),
          Script = tostring(Properties["fleetwise.script"]), Manager = tostring(Properties["fleetwise.manager"]);
calls
| summarize Input = sum(Input), Output = sum(Output), Calls = count(), Agents = make_set(strcat(Agent, ":", Version)), First = min(TimeGenerated) by OperationId
| join kind=leftouter runs on OperationId
| extend Started = coalesce(Started, First), Script = iif(isempty(Script), "other (portal, eval, CI)", Script)
| project Started, Run, Script, Manager, Agents = strcat_array(Agents, ", "), Calls, Input, Output, Total = Input + Output, ['Cost (USD)'] = cost(Input, Output)
| order by Started desc
content.title: Runs: what each demo command consumed

content.query:
let calls = AppDependencies
| where tostring(Properties["microsoft.foundry"]) == "True" and tostring(Properties["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "chat"
| extend Agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]), Version = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.version"]),
         Model = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.response.model"]),
         Input = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), Output = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| extend Agent = iif(isempty(Agent), "(model call without agent)", Agent);
let cost = (i: long, o: long) { round(i / 1000000.0 * {InputPrice} + o / 1000000.0 * {OutputPrice}, 4) };
calls
| summarize Calls = count(), Input = sum(Input), Output = sum(Output) by Agent, Version, Model
| extend ['Tokens per call'] = (Input + Output) / Calls, ['Cost (USD)'] = cost(Input, Output)
| order by Agent asc, toint(Version) desc
content.title: By agent version: compare naive vs hardened, per call

content.json:
## Whole Foundry account
All model traffic on the account, from Azure Monitor platform metrics: agents, plus evaluation judges, memory extraction, and embeddings, which do not run as agent calls. Metrics arrive in about 5 minutes.

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.COGNITIVESERVICES" and MetricName in ("InputTokens", "OutputTokens")
| summarize Tokens = sum(Total) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), MetricName
content.title: Account tokens per hour (all deployments)
